title: Watchdog benchmark — per-finding verdicts
description: One record per audited finding. A published run ships one of these per tool; noise_stats.py recomputes the number from it. CSV form uses the same column names as these properties.

repo.description: The repository the finding is in — the cluster the primary (bootstrap) interval resamples over. Use a stable identifier, e.g. owner/name@<sha>.

class.description: The five-class taxonomy verdict (METHOD.md §1). noise = the four non-valid classes.

id.description: The finding's stable id within its report.

dimension.description: The scoring dimension the finding belongs to (e.g. D3, D34).

language.description: The finding's primary language, for the per-language breakdown.

rater.description: Who produced this verdict: the pinned machine judge id, or an anonymised human rater id (e.g. rater-A / rater-B). A published run carries both machine and human verdicts.

evidence_defect.description: The finding is right in substance but wrong in coordinates (still valid; increments a separately-published evidence-defect rate). Never folded into the noise ratio.

reason.description: The concrete basis for the verdict (file/line/mechanism checked).
